company.description: Ardis AI develops a toolkit for natural language understanding that extracts structured information from raw text. Ardis AI's software builds a simulation, it understands the goals, beliefs, and assertions of the people discussed in the text, it reasons about spatial and temporal relationships, and stores and learns from its experiences.
